note: Since the pause (2026-10-09) the 10 earlier examples are Draft in Notion and are not loaded; they stay here as eval fixtures (expectedCase maps the category for the eval). One Active example with a response.

examples.name: Cancellation, vague reason, ask before acting
examples.customerMessage: [Cancellation feedback] Reason: inaccurate. Message: the followers/following are not chronological.

examples.name: Refund request, within 30 days, unused
examples.customerMessage: I'd like to cancel and get a refund. I intended to cancel after the free trial but forgot before the billing date, and I haven't used the Pro features since being billed.

examples.name: Billing, bank chargeback with Stripe timeline
examples.customerMessage: [From the member's credit union] Our member disputes three charges and states she cancelled three weeks ago but is still being charged. Please refund to avoid the chargeback process.

examples.name: Billing, catch-up charges after failed payments
examples.customerMessage: You charged my card 3 times in one week! What is going on?

examples.name: Question, private profile not accessible
examples.customerMessage: The profile I want to track is private, but I follow them on Instagram. On a paid plan, will I be able to see their followers?

examples.name: Question, fluctuating follower count
examples.customerMessage: The follower count keeps going up but nothing new shows up. I don't trust that it's accurate.

examples.name: Feature request, log and notify at release
examples.customerMessage: Can you change the automatic names when downloading pictures and videos? They are all named media.mp4 or thumbnail.jpg, hard to list. Adding date and time would be great.

examples.name: Bug report, false post-deletion alerts
examples.customerMessage: I keep getting notifications that posts are being deleted every day from someone I'm tracking, but nothing is actually deleted when I check.

examples.name: Safety / removal, act immediately
examples.customerMessage: I request the immediate removal of my profile from your website and that my stories are blocked from anonymous viewing. I have safety concerns and have received threats.

examples.name: Service status, down for good or temporarily
examples.customerMessage: Is InstaRadar down forever or only temporarily?
examples.response:
Hi, thanks for reaching out!

InstaRadar is currently paused. There is an issue with our access to Instagram data, and it is outside of our control. We are working on it, but we cannot say yet whether or when InstaRadar will be back.

What this means for you:
- Your subscription has been paused, and you will not be charged while InstaRadar is down.
- We will email you as soon as we know more.

I am sorry for the trouble. If you have any questions about your subscription, just reply to this email.

Best regards,
Anastasia
InstaRadar Support
